items.abstract: <jats:p>MIT's <em> Technology Review </em> has posted an 8.5 minute podcast of Tim Berners-Lee talking about the semantic web. I haven't had time to listen yet, but according to Brian Robinson, TBL says that the semantic web will require "more open access to data".</jats:p>
title: Open data for the semantic web
